---
title: "Site Map"
---

Every page on this site is produced by one of four mechanisms. Knowing which one
applies tells you how much of the page was written by a person, how much was
carried over unchanged from the repository, and where to look for the original.

## Output Types

| Type | Meaning |
|------|----------|
| **VERBATIM** | Source `.md` morphed to `.qmd` with YAML frontmatter added; content preserved exactly |
| **COMPOSED** | Authored by the Publishing Writer; synthesized from one or more raw sources per the contract brief |
| **ADAPTED** | Source `.md`/`.qmd` transformed with non-editorial Technical Bridge operations (for example link rewriting, include injection, section exclusions, and sanitization), with all transforms documented in `TRANSFORM_LOG.md` |
| **REDIRECT** | Transit `.qmd` stub that forwards the browser to a standalone rendered HTML file |

## Navigation Structure

```text
Maelstrom Harmonization
│
├── 🏠  Index                        COMPOSED  ← mission, pipeline guide, and both
│                                              manifests; absent from the navbar
│
├── Project
│   ├── Mission                      VERBATIM  ← ai/project/mission.md
│   ├── Method                       VERBATIM  ← ai/project/method.md
│   └── Glossary                     VERBATIM  ← ai/project/glossary.md
│
├── Pipeline
│   ├── Pipeline Guide               ADAPTED   ← manipulation/pipeline.md
│   │                                            (transforms: shortcode_injection,
│   │                                            sanitize, extension_promotion,
│   │                                            frontmatter_add)
│   ├── Cache Manifest               VERBATIM  ← data-public/metadata/CACHE-manifest.md
│   └── Input Manifest               VERBATIM  ← data-public/metadata/INPUT-manifest.md
│
├── Primers
│   └── Data Primer 1                REDIRECT  → reports/data-primer-1.html
│
└── Site Map                         COMPOSED  ← this site's publishing contract
```

## Build System

The site is a static Quarto project with an explicit render list — every page is named
individually; nothing is discovered by wildcard.

One post-render hook runs after Quarto finishes:

| Script | Hook | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| `scripts/copy-primer-html.R` | post-render | Copies the standalone Data Primer 1 HTML into the rendered site so the Primers redirect resolves |

The Pipeline Guide's architecture diagram is rendered from a Mermaid partial
(`_mermaid-pipeline.qmd`) extracted from the source document, so the diagram on that
page stays tied to the pipeline's own documentation. The home page uses a pre-rendered
PNG of the same diagram.

## Not Yet Present

There is no Analysis section. The repository's first substantive exploratory analysis
has not been composed; this frontend was built to be extended, and an Analysis entry
will sit between Pipeline and Primers when that work exists.
